Spot On - Pitter-patter of tiny paws as a quartet of Cheetah cubs born at Longleat.

Staff at the Wiltshire safari park are celebrating a record big cat litter for miracle mum Wilma.

It's extremely rare to get four cubs all surviving, even in captivity. And in the wild only 1 in 3 cubs would be expected to reach adulthood.

Part of a captive breeding program, the two boys and two girls are a ray of hope for the 'Vulnerable' species whose habitat is threatened in Africa.

This carriage was made available to foreign rulers while they were visiting Austria (for instance, the future King Edward VII of England used it, and so did Kaiser Wilhelm II of Germany).
